# Security

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately to the maintainers so it can be addressed before public disclosure.

Suggested process:

1. Email security@REPO_OWNER.com with a clear description and reproduction steps.
2. Include any relevant proof-of-concept and impact assessment.
3. Maintainers will acknowledge within a few business days and provide an estimated timeline for a fix.

Do not create public issues for security vulnerabilities.
